limitations: Rebuilt alignment, not the unreleased original author alignment.
Taxa are the boreoeutherian union of both Methods accession lists; this is not asserted to reproduce the exact Figure 4 panel.

Rat source has one ambiguous W nucleotide translating to X.
Paper substitution positions require an explicit coordinate crosswalk; they are not necessarily human CDS indices.
